crons.comment: Records one KSE breadth reading per trading day so Breadth can eventually be percentile-ranked like the other signals — PSX keeps no breadth archive, so the only way to have this history is to write it down daily. 11:00 UTC is 16:00 PKT, half an hour after the PSX close, and Mon-Fri because the exchange does not trade at weekends. Hobby allows daily-or-slower schedules, which this is.
